run_color_transfer_training: run the color transfer training between two images using optimal transport and ICNN models
pretrain_identity_mapping: pretrain the ICNN network to satisfy the identity pushforward constraint with L2 regularization
compute_dual_objective: compute the dual objective value for the optimal transport problem between source and target distributions
push_image_through_network: push an image through the trained ICNN network to transform its color distribution
save_workspace_state: save the current workspace state including trained model parameters to a pickle file
